test_GIL_deadlock_single_thread: test for GIL deadlock when calling C++ callbacks that return to Python from a single thread
test_GIL_deadlock_parallel_threads: test for GIL deadlock when calling C++ callbacks from 8 parallel Python threads
test_GIL_deadlock_sequential_threads: test for GIL deadlock when calling C++ callbacks from 8 sequential Python threads
test_GIL_deadlock_multiprocess: test for GIL deadlock when calling C++ callbacks that return to Python from a separate process
run_target_in_subprocess: run a target function in a subprocess with a 10 second timeout and return its exit code
